description: We are Salvador and Leandro, final-year IT students at Universidad ORT Uruguay. In our capstone project we’re building a real-time rainfall visualizer for Uruguay’s meteorology institute (INUMET), working with weather data, interactive maps and full-stack web dev (React, Node.js, SQL Server, Azure). We want to use NASA Earth data on rainfall, soil moisture and water stress to build a practical web tool for agriculture. We work fast and aim to deliver a working prototype.
